name: qfd_res_train_issue_c2-c2-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen compute die v1.4 master qfd_res_train_issue (x1): result-train command issuer, 30.24 um square frame (die 129.6 frame measured util 2%: slot change requested), die faces; recipe 3 pin registers on every input/output (+1 edge in, +1 out: the compiler TRAIN_EDGES absorbs them); rst_n captured by one station flop (cold init only). TRAIN_EDGES 11 = the last computed die value (globalfp_q_1705 te-fpq_s6.json); the die netlist_0030 instance carries no TRAIN_EDGES (RTL default -1 refuses elaboration) -> Q-COMPUTE-DIE must confirm/assign the r2h value incl. the 2 pin-register edges (re-route of this 129.6 tile if it differs).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_res_train_issue #(.TRAIN_EDGES(11), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_res_train_issue.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: rti_exact_400_instructions
bench.pass_regex: RTI_BENCH PASS MUT=0 TE=11 starts=400 instructions=400 errors=0

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_res_train_issue_c2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_res_train_issue_c2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_res_train_issue_c2 --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_res_train_issue  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
